name: AWR Load Profile 指标解读诊断
description: AWR Load Profile 展示数据库在快照期间的负载量指标（Per Second 和 Per Transaction）。关键指标包括 DB Time、Redo Size、Logical/Physical Reads、User Calls、Executions、Transactions 等。通过对比不同时段的 Load Profile 可以判断负载变化。

skip_when.desc: 已知的负载变化（如促销活动）

root_causes.name: 业务量增长
root_causes.desc: 正常业务增长导致 User Calls/Executions 增加。

root_causes.name: SQL 效率下降
root_causes.desc: Logical Reads Per Execution 增加说明 SQL 效率变差（执行计划变更）。

root_causes.name: Redo 异常增长
root_causes.desc: Redo Size Per Second 异常增长可能是大批量 DML 或 NOLOGGING 操作未生效。

root_causes.name: 硬解析增加
root_causes.desc: Hard Parse Per Second 增加说明新 SQL 或未绑定变量的 SQL 增多。

oltp.desc: 关注 Per Transaction 指标，评估单事务效率

olap.desc: 关注 Per Second 总吞吐量

step1_load_profile.sql: SELECT metric_name, ROUND(AVG(value), 2) avg_val, ROUND(MAX(value), 2) max_val FROM dba_hist_sysmetric_summary s JOIN dba_hist_snapshot sn ON s.snap_id = sn.snap_id WHERE metric_name IN ('DB Time Per Sec', 'DB Block Gets Per Sec', 'Consistent Read Gets Per Sec', 'Physical Reads Per Sec', 'Physical Writes Per Sec', 'Redo Generated Per Sec', 'User Calls Per Sec', 'Executions Per Sec', 'Hard Parse Count Per Sec', 'User Commits Per Sec') AND sn.begin_interval_time > SYSDATE - INTERVAL '2' HOUR GROUP BY metric_name

step2_compare_load.sql: SELECT metric_name, ROUND(curr.avg_val, 2) current_avg, ROUND(prev.avg_val, 2) previous_avg, ROUND((curr.avg_val - prev.avg_val)/GREATEST(prev.avg_val, 0.01)*100, 1) change_pct FROM (SELECT metric_name, AVG(value) avg_val FROM dba_hist_sysmetric_summary s JOIN dba_hist_snapshot sn ON s.snap_id = sn.snap_id WHERE sn.begin_interval_time > SYSDATE - INTERVAL '2' HOUR GROUP BY metric_name) curr LEFT JOIN (SELECT metric_name, AVG(value) avg_val FROM dba_hist_sysmetric_summary s JOIN dba_hist_snapshot sn ON s.snap_id = sn.snap_id WHERE sn.begin_interval_time BETWEEN SYSDATE - 7 - INTERVAL '2' HOUR AND SYSDATE - 7 GROUP BY metric_name) prev ON curr.metric_name = prev.metric_name ORDER BY ABS(change_pct) DESC NULLS LAST
